objective: Independently reconstruct the renewal-code, pressure, companion-threshold, formal-countermodel, and canonical-residue results from two scratch audits, accepting only separately proved or verified statements and preserving the anti-concentration gap.

quantifiers: all first strict upcrossing words for the symbolic theorem statements
all finite-DP states through full-word length 512
all renewal addresses with total odd count Q at most 12 and block count from 1 through 4
all ordinary heights from 1 through 2048 in the canonical-residue finite audit
the first 4096 odd exponents of the square-root critical countermodel
exact_scope.completeness: The finite computations are exhaustive only in the stated domains. P77-P79 use separate exact proofs. P80 is only a quantified conditional implication and does not assert either anti-concentration premise.

arithmetic.floating_point_role: Decimal approximations are reporting-only; integers, Fraction, and exact power comparisons decide acceptance.

verifier_reconstructs: finite pressure DP and analytic-bound witnesses
universal threshold extrema and equality word
critical recurrence, inverse residue digest, and finite height exclusion
canonical source and endpoint residues, finite counts, lattice errors, and cylinder compatibility
raw coefficient-one Haar-volume counterexample and exact pressure factors

stop_conditions: Stop and preserve the least exact obstruction if a symbolic identity, digest, or independent reconstruction fails.
Do not enlarge a finite range to conceal a failed universal statement or promote finite trends to asymptotic claims.
Keep H72 open unless ordinary-positive anti-concentration itself is proved and independently audited.
Enter the proof-claim emergency protocol before any change to proves_collatz.
interpretation_boundary: The endpoint and two-sided anti-concentration estimates are premises, not Phase 13 conclusions.
A coherent 2-adic source is not a positive ordinary integer.
Haar measure does not control a designated least positive canonical representative.
No finite DP or address enumeration proves an asymptotic theorem.
